title: Build a11y test harness and remediation runbook for component tokens and data grids
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: Build an automated accessibility test harness and an accompanying remediation runbook targeted at the design system token layer, interactive buttons, table/data-grid patterns, and chart tooltips/legends. The goal is to produce repeatable CI checks, a prioritized fix list, and a VPAT-ready evidence package for the next design release.

Scope: token contrast ramp checks, color-theme permutations (default, high-contrast, grayscale-friendly), keyboard navigation scenarios (roving tabindex and modal stacking), semantic ARIA for table headers and sortable columns, screen-reader announcements for chart tooltips and live regions, and an automated evidence export for VPAT reviewers.

Out of scope: full rewrite of data-grid virtualization logic, backend API changes, and third-party library replacements (we will surface blockers as dependencies).

Why now: Rising enterprise demand for VPAT evidence plus recurring accessibility bugs reported in support metrics. Creating a test harness reduces manual verification time and lets eng/design triage regressions earlier in the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: 1) CI job 'a11y:ci' runs on PRs and fails for new critical/serious violations; baseline recorded in dashboard
2) Contrast scanner validates token palettes across three themes and writes a remediation report mapping token -> suggested replacement
3) Data-grid rows and headers expose correct ARIA attributes (role=grid / aria-colindex / aria-sort) with automated tests covering sorting and screen reader announcements
4) Chart legend and tooltip keyboard flows use roving tabindex and a polite live region for tooltip text; tests simulate keyboard-only navigation
5) Runbook document (Confluence) includes prioritized fixes, owners, estimated effort, and a VPAT evidence checklist exportable as CSV/PDF
6) Initial remediation PRs merged for top-5 highest-impact violations with design review and playbacks scheduled
comments: 2025-11-10 Ava Martinez: Created ticket — initial scope and goals. Flagged as high priority due to upcoming enterprise audit. Linking existing audit artifacts.
2025-11-11 Liam O'Connor: Drafted test harness plan — propose axe-core + Pa11y + contrast-scan script that runs token permutations. Need infra support to run browser tests in CI matrix.
2025-11-12 Maya Chen (PM): Approved scope. Please estimate and include a short rollout plan for customers on Dedicated plans that expect VPAT artifacts.
2025-11-13 Noah Patel (Eng): Engineering feedback — suggested using Playwright for keyboard simulation tests and a separate headless run for contrast scanner. Will attach a prototype job template.
2025-11-14 Design review (Figma): Updated component tokens file with proposed token swap suggestions for WCAG AA in default theme. Figma link attached in attachments.

2025-11-15 Liam O'Connor: Ran initial axe scan on components playground. Results: 42 violations -> 9 remaining after first-pass token changes. Attached violation export and mapping. Next: address keyboard trapping in chart tooltips and add aria-sort to table headers.

2025-11-16 Ava Martinez: Added remediation runbook outline — priority matrix (customer impact x effort), communication plan for release notes, and VPAT evidence template. Scheduling canary release with fixes for 2025-12 sprint.
decisions: Adopt combined approach: axe-core (regressions), Pa11y (site-level checks), Playwright for keyboard/interaction simulations, and a custom contrast-scanner for token permutations.
ARIA conventions: use role=grid for data tables, aria-colindex on cells, and aria-sort on sortable headers. Use visually-hidden live regions with aria-live='polite' for chart tooltip text.
Keyboard model: implement roving tabindex for toolbar/legend items and ensure modal stacking uses inert attribute pattern for background nodes.
VPAT: produce a reproducible evidence package (test-run output + screenshots + design token mapping) and store versioned artifacts in Confluence release page.
review_feedback: Maya Chen (PM): Emphasize VPAT readiness for Dedicated customers; include a short summary of residual exceptions and compensating controls.
Noah Patel (Eng): Suggested breaking the work into 3 engineering tickets: CI harness, data-grid fixes, chart/tooltip fixes. Wants separate estimates.
Priya Rao (Accessibility consultant): Recommended adding colorblindness simulation to contrast scanner and to validate focus-visible states across themes.
